title: Cerebus Melmoth One #140 Nov 1990 Aardvark-Vanaheim Comics ISSN 0712-7774
descriptionText:
Dive into the fascinating world of Cerebus with issue number 140, titled "Melmoth One," published in November 1990. This comic book offers a unique blend of storytelling and artistry, crafted by the renowned duo Dave Sim and Gerhard. As part of the iconic "Cerebus" series, this issue continues the saga of the aardvark character through the Copper Age of comics.

Aardvark-Vanaheim's dedication to quality is evident on every page, and this issue is no exception, showcasing the intricate detail and rich narratives that have become hallmarks of the series. Whether you're a long-time collector or new to the series, "Cerebus Melmoth One #140" stands as a testament to the enduring legacy of US comics tradition and the creative excellence of its era.
